caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden cabinet or nightstand, centrally positioned against a plain, lightly textured beige background. The cabinet has a rectangular top and stands on four straight legs. The front face features a single square door with a beveled frame, decorated with a red and black geometric pattern forming an inner border. There is a central round black metal keyhole plate with a matching small knob below it. The wood appears to be a light brown color with visible grain texture. A subtle gray shadow is cast behind and to the left of the cabinet, suggesting a light source from the right. The overall composition is minimal, with the cabinet alone in the center of the otherwise empty background.
title: Side View of Blanket Chest
